qs.q: The most common cause of acquired coagulation disorder is ---
qs.e: The liver synthesizes most coagulation factors, so hepatic dysfunction is an important acquired cause of coagulopathy.

qs.q: Most common cause of acquired coagulation disorder?
qs.e: The liver synthesizes nearly all coagulation factors — liver disease is the most common acquired coagulopathy globally.
